$comment: The authored main arc. Story: docs/campaigns/gemfall.md. Wiring — which flags each chapter must set, which survive between evenings, the facets — docs/campaigns/gemfall-authoring.md. Every flag a later chapter reads is a member of a route set below, because only those cross the chapter boundary; most sets select no chapter and exist purely as the campaign's memory.
title: Gemfall
blurb: Mount Red Sky has erupted, and gemstones are raining across the realm. Everybody is racing north to grab them. Your party is racing too. Nobody has asked yet why the stones hum.

lastTime.$comment: Read on the shared screen before a chapter's first scene (#357): the lines for the route-set flags a party carried in, the newest few in this order, which is story order, then the chapter's goal. A party carrying none hears the opener. Every routeSets member has a line (content:validate); a line naming a great stone reads the inventory.
lastTime.opener: A brand new adventure starts tonight. Mount Red Sky has rumbled, gemstones are falling out of the sky, and everybody is racing north.

lines.motive_wealth: You went north for the treasure. Gems, gems, gems!
lines.motive_curiosity: You went north to find out what really happened to the mountain.
lines.motive_prestige: You went north so that everybody would know your names.
lines.motive_duty: You went north because somebody has to keep folk safe.
lines.motive_fresh_start: You went north for a fresh start somewhere new.
lines.motive_proving: You went north to prove you could do it.
lines.ember_sold: You sold the warm red stone on the quay, for a purse so heavy it clanked.

ember_kept.text: You kept the warm red stone from the quay. It is still in your pack, humming away.
ember_kept.otherwise: You kept the warm red stone from the quay, though it is not in your pack now.

lines.sprites_friends: The little sprites in the vegetable rows decided you are their friends.
lines.sprites_wronged: You snatched the shiny stone from the sprites' vegetable row, and the sprites will not forget it.
lines.route_river: You picked the River Road, east toward the crossing.
lines.route_rush: Your road runs north with the rush, packed with wagons and very slow.
lines.route_wild: Your road goes west, into the wild, wet country past the marsh.
lines.crossed_dry: You crossed the big river and kept your socks dry.
lines.river_took_us: The river picked you up and carried you south, like a parcel nobody signed for.
lines.forded_clean: You got over the river's west branch, right where you meant to.
lines.marsh_kept_us: The marsh grabbed you, and its channels carried you west until they finally let go.
lines.walked_over: You squelched out of the bog and fell in behind a sausage cart on the busy north road.
lines.glade_mended: The sick gray glade in the forest is green again, and its stone is back in the ground.

glade_finished.text: You took the humming stone from the gray glade. It is still in your pack, and the glade is still gray.
glade_finished.otherwise: You took the humming stone from the gray glade, and the glade stayed gray.

lines.refused_the_cult: When the kind soup folk asked for your help, you said no thank you.
lines.funded_the_break: You gave the kind soup folk something for their plan, and they were very, very glad.
lines.told_wardens: You told the wardens everything you found, and they wrote it all down.
lines.told_gatherers: You sent your news to the gatherers, and somewhere a bell rang.
lines.kept_close: You kept what you found to yourselves, folded up small.
lines.pursuit_restore: Your road is putting the stones back, every one of them, even the hard way.
lines.pursuit_hoard: You said you would finish the collection. Nobody at the citadel knows what to make of that.
lines.pursuit_leash: You chose the leash: hold what sleeps under the mountain, not break it and not bury it.
lines.clock_steady: The mountain is grumbling slow and low, and you are in good time.
lines.clock_stirring: The ground has started to shrug now and then. The mountain is stirring.
lines.clock_late: The ground is shaking slow and steady, like a drum. Time is getting short.
